decision.reason: The previous SAM extraction was blocked because the source owner component escaped localization and the mask cut the foreground. The handshake icon is a complete semantic asset that requires an independent transparent PNG with verified source coverage. Retrying asset extraction allows the host to re-evaluate the LayerD/source evidence to establish a complete matte that includes the full handshake shape without clipping, resolving the 'source owner component escapes localization' failure.

The retry_asset_extraction tool returned CANDIDATE_READY with all independent checks (source_binding, content_verification, owner_coverage, protected_peer_integrity, background_proof, region_atomicity) passing. The transparent_asset_preview shows the complete handshake icon without clipping, and the backing_after_asset_removal preview confirms clean removal from the source region. Per policy, when a tool reports CANDIDATE_READY, the next step is to accept the candidate pending Office and Go validation.
